title: Polynomial Source Output
statement: For natural numbers $c,C$ and a Boolean word $s$, consider the specified unary-output machine with $c+1$ work tapes and its polynomial-cost bound. Starting from the bank configuration on input $s$ in the loop state indexed by $c$, after $\mathrm{cost}(|s|+1,C,c+1)+1$ steps it is halted and its output consists of exactly $C(|s|+1)^{c+1}$ copies of true.
hypotheses_covered: c and C are natural numbers
